how_to_read: Find the diagnosis connector in the engine bay (driver side, near the shock tower / fuse box area).
Jumper the TEN terminal to the GND terminal with a short wire or paper clip.
Turn the ignition on without starting the engine.
Count the check engine light flashes: long flashes (about 1.2 s) are tens, short flashes (about 0.4 s) are ones. Codes repeat after a pause.
If the light stays off after it first lights up, no codes are stored.
To clear codes after a repair: disconnect the negative battery cable for at least 20 seconds and press the brake pedal (this drains the ECU memory), reconnect, then check again.
